runtime.scope: Client-keyed session creation, query-string session parameters, direct part request, paused/buffering/stopped transitions.

X-Plex-Session-Identifier and X-Plex-Client-Identifier identity, cross-item replacement, stop without time. The terminal capture truncated; the probe's sanitized observation file holds the full sequence.

environment: Copied initialized local profile in a loopback-only network namespace; two synthetic 4 s rawvideo movies; admin token. No official client executed.
observations: A timeline report with state=playing and a client identifier creates one Video in /status/sessions with sessionKey, viewOffset=time, duration, User id and a Player carrying machineIdentifier, product, version, state and userID.
Query parameters session and sessionIdentifier did not create a separate session; the client-keyed entry was updated.
Each distinct X-Plex-Session-Identifier header created a new session with the next sessionKey, even for the same client and item.
A report reusing a session header with a different client identifier and item replaced that session's item and player in place, keeping its sessionKey.
state=stopped without time removed the matching session.
paused and buffering updated Player.state and viewOffset; stopped removed the session; other sessions were unaffected.
Timeline responses were empty MediaContainers (size 0) in every case.

implementation_contract.identity: (account, X-Plex-Session-Identifier) when the header is present, otherwise (account, X-Plex-Client-Identifier). Matches observation; account scoping is Sloplex design.
implementation_contract.lifecycle: stopped deletes the entry when it names the same item. Entries expire 2 minutes after their last report, with 32 per account and 256 total, oldest evicted (sloplex).
implementation_contract.publication: Sessions are published only after the playstate/queue save succeeds; access is rechecked on every listing (sloplex).
implementation_contract.access: GET /status/sessions requires an admin (sloplex; PMS was observed with its admin token only).

limitations: Transcode session fields (TranscodeSession, decisions, bandwidth) were not compared.
PMS session expiry timing and limits were not measured.
Stopping a session with a different item than it holds was not observed.
No official-client playback flow has been executed.
